title: Tilt-excess/height estimate (Simon 5.2.1)
statement: For every n >= 1 there is C depending only on n such that for every l, open U in R^(n+l), contract rectifiable n-varifold V = v(M,theta) in U with generalized mean curvature H in U, point xi and rho > 0 with closed B_rho(xi) in U, and n-dimensional subspace T: E(xi, rho/2, T) <= C rho^-n integral_{B_rho(xi)} (dist(x - xi, T)/rho)^2 dmu_V + C rho^(2-n) integral_{B_rho(xi)} |H|^2 dmu_V, where E(xi,s,T) = s^-n integral_{B_s(xi)} |p_{T_xM} - p_T|^2 dmu_V (Hilbert-Schmidt norm) and the |H|^2 integral is an extended integral (inequality in [0,inf]).
